en.headline: M+ autumn cinema season screens Mark Lee films
en.dek: The West Kowloon museum says its October-to-December cinema edition is on sale, led by a ten-film tribute to cinematographer Mark Lee Ping-bing.
body: M+ said its cinema autumn edition, running from October to December, is open for ticket sales on the major programmes, with M+ Cinema redemption vouchers accepted for selected screenings.

The museum said the centrepiece is Lightcatcher, a ten-film tribute to cinematographer Mark Lee Ping-bing, paired with a masterclass and a documentary about his work. Listed titles include The Time to Live and the Time to Die, Summer Snow, Fallen Angels, Flowers of Shanghai and The Assassin. A related strand, Rediscoveries, will show Hou Hsiao-hsien's Cafe Lumiere and Akira Kurosawa's Seven Samurai on 35mm.

Other announced screenings include Mamoru Oshii's Ghost in the Shell and Ghost in the Shell 2: Innocence, tied to the museum's Myths and Monsters exhibition, and a restored 183-minute version of Masaki Kobayashi's Kwaidan. M+ also named Hong Kong filmmaker Jiang Wenjie's debut documentary Almost Home, about writers Hon Lai-chu, Lee Wai-yi and Human Ip. The museum said further details of the M+ Restored Festival, which will bring nine restored Hong Kong titles back to the cinema, would be announced later.

zh.headline: M+秋季電影節放映李屏賓作品
zh.dek: 西九M+表示，10月至12月的電影季主要節目已公開售票，主軸是攝影師李屏賓的十部作品回顧。
body: M+表示，電影院秋季節目由10月起至12月，主要節目現已公開售票，指定場次可使用M+電影換票證。
博物館指，今季核心是「追光者」單元，放映十部由攝影師李屏賓掌鏡的電影，並配以大師班及一部關於他的紀錄片。公布列出的作品包括《童年往事》、《女人四十》、《墮落天使》、《海上花》及《刺客聶隱娘》。相關單元「再發現」會以35毫米菲林放映侯孝賢的《咖啡時光》及黑澤明的《七武士》。
其他已公布場次包括押井守的《攻殼機動隊》及《攻殼機動隊2：無罪》，與館內「神話與怪物」展覽對讀，以及小林正樹《怪談》修復版183分鐘完整版。M+亦點名香港新晉導演姜文傑的首部長片紀錄片《將近之家》，片中訪問作家韓麗珠、李維怡及葉曉文。博物館表示，九部香港經典修復作品的「M+修復電影節」詳情容後公布。
